name: Gallade
flavorText: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

levelUp.name: Leaf Blade
levelUp.description: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

levelUp.name: Night Slash
levelUp.description: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

levelUp.name: Leer
levelUp.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

levelUp.name: Confusion
levelUp.description: The foe is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the foe confused.

levelUp.name: Double Team
levelUp.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

levelUp.name: Teleport
levelUp.description: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It may also be used to warp to the last Poké Center visited.

levelUp.name: Fury Cutter
levelUp.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

levelUp.name: Slash
levelUp.description: The foe is attacked with a slash of claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

levelUp.name: Swords Dance
levelUp.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

levelUp.name: Psycho Cut
levelUp.description: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

levelUp.name: Helping Hand
levelUp.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

levelUp.name: Feint
levelUp.description: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

levelUp.name: False Swipe
levelUp.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

levelUp.name: Low Kick
levelUp.description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

levelUp.name: Protect
levelUp.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

levelUp.name: Close Combat
levelUp.description: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

levelUp.name: Magic Coat
levelUp.description: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

tmHm.name: Focus Punch
tmHm.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

tmHm.name: Calm Mind
tmHm.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tmHm.name: Toxic
tmHm.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tmHm.name: Bulk Up
tmHm.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

tmHm.name: Hidden Power
tmHm.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

tmHm.name: Sunny Day
tmHm.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tmHm.name: Taunt
tmHm.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

tmHm.name: Hyper Beam
tmHm.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

tmHm.name: Light Screen
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Protect
tmHm.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Rain Dance
tmHm.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

tmHm.name: Safeguard
tmHm.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

tmHm.name: Frustration
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Thunderbolt
tmHm.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

tmHm.name: Earthquake
tmHm.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

tmHm.name: Return
tmHm.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

tmHm.name: Psychic
tmHm.description: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Shadow Ball
tmHm.description: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

tmHm.name: Brick Break
tmHm.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

tmHm.name: Double Team
tmHm.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

tmHm.name: Reflect
tmHm.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tmHm.name: Shock Wave
tmHm.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

tmHm.name: Rock Tomb
tmHm.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

tmHm.name: Aerial Ace
tmHm.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

tmHm.name: Torment
tmHm.description: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

tmHm.name: Facade
tmHm.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

tmHm.name: Secret Power
tmHm.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

tmHm.name: Rest
tmHm.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

tmHm.name: Attract
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

tmHm.name: Thief
tmHm.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

tmHm.name: Skill Swap
tmHm.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

tmHm.name: Snatch
tmHm.description: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat- changing move the foe attempts to use.

tmHm.name: Focus Blast
tmHm.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

tmHm.name: False Swipe
tmHm.description: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

tmHm.name: Fling
tmHm.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

tmHm.name: Charge Beam
tmHm.description: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Endure
tmHm.description: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tmHm.name: Drain Punch
tmHm.description: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tmHm.name: Recycle
tmHm.description: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

tmHm.name: Giga Impact
tmHm.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

tmHm.name: Flash
tmHm.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

tmHm.name: Stone Edge
tmHm.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

tmHm.name: Thunder Wave
tmHm.description: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

tmHm.name: Swords Dance
tmHm.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Psych Up
tmHm.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

tmHm.name: Captivate
tmHm.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

tmHm.name: Rock Slide
tmHm.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

tmHm.name: X-Scissor
tmHm.description: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tmHm.name: Sleep Talk
tmHm.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tmHm.name: Natural Gift
tmHm.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

tmHm.name: Poison Jab
tmHm.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

tmHm.name: Dream Eater
tmHm.description: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.

tmHm.name: Grass Knot
tmHm.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

tmHm.name: Swagger
tmHm.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

tmHm.name: Substitute
tmHm.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

tmHm.name: Trick Room
tmHm.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

tmHm.name: Cut
tmHm.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

tmHm.name: Strength
tmHm.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

tmHm.name: Rock Smash
tmHm.description: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.

tutor.name: Mud-Slap
tutor.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

tutor.name: Fury Cutter
tutor.description: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

tutor.name: ThunderPunch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.

tutor.name: Fire Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

tutor.name: Ice Punch
tutor.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

tutor.name: Snore
tutor.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

tutor.name: Helping Hand
tutor.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

tutor.name: Signal Beam
tutor.description: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

tutor.name: Zen Headbutt
tutor.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

tutor.name: Vacuum Wave
tutor.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

tutor.name: Trick
tutor.description: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

tutor.name: Knock Off
tutor.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

tutor.name: Swift
tutor.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.
